checkpoints.message:
fix: use recorded response-file archive rules for Node WASIX source builds

The original source build failed at the OpenSSL archive command length boundary. Extend the fixed upstream GYP normal/thin response-file branch to WASI/wasm, with exact preimage/patch/postimage and post-build source-diff checks. Preserve original generated target rules and response inputs. Driver, resource limits, cells and restore criteria remain unchanged.

A finite local GNU make/native ar diagnostic reproduces the oversized printf failure and preserves all 928 ordered members through both existing response-file helpers. Retain the initial ptrace refusal and exact successful probe source separately. This is not a WASIX/Node build or runtime pass; no hosted build was repeated. Independent source review also bounded interrupted-probe reap; that error path was not exercised.
checkpoints.verification_scope: source preservation only; not a product test
